name: inbox-check
description: Email deliverability test API. Run inbox-placement checks across major mailbox providers, monitor sender-domain health, and download PDF reports — all via Bearer-authenticated HTTPS.

schemes.description: API keys issued at https://check.live-direct-marketing.online/account. Each key carries scope and quota.

skills.name: Caller introspection — key metadata + current period usage
skills.description: Returns this key's tier, scopes, allowed providers, and daily/monthly usage counters. Useful for self-checking remaining quota before a batch.

skills.name: List a domain’s check history
skills.description: Returns past deliverability check results for the domain, newest first.

skills.name: Add a domain to monitoring
skills.description: Registers a domain for recurring SPF/DMARC/MX/blocklist/TLS checks. Requires a user-bound API key.

skills.name: Remove a monitored domain
skills.description: Stops monitoring and deletes the domain and its check history. Irreversible.

skills.name: Get a domain’s latest check
skills.description: Returns the most recent deliverability check result for the domain.

skills.name: List monitored domains
skills.description: Returns all domains under continuous deliverability monitoring for the key owner, plus the per-user active-domain limit.

skills.name: Pause monitoring for a domain
skills.description: Suspends scheduled checks for the domain without deleting its history.

skills.name: Resume monitoring for a domain
skills.description: Re-enables scheduled checks for a previously paused domain.

skills.name: Run an on-demand check now
skills.description: Triggers an immediate deliverability check for the domain, outside the schedule.

skills.name: Get monitoring notification settings
skills.description: Returns the key owner’s alert/digest/webhook/telegram monitoring preferences.

skills.name: Update monitoring notification settings
skills.description: Patches alert thresholds, digest frequency, webhook and telegram delivery options.

skills.name: List available providers
skills.description: Lists all deliverability providers, marking which ones the calling key may use (with a reason for those it can’t) so clients can surface accurate upgrade prompts.

skills.name: Get a permanent sender page: seed addresses, latest runs, reports state
skills.description: Get a permanent sender page: seed addresses, latest runs, reports state

skills.name: Create a deliverability test (auto mode — per-recipient single-seed)
skills.description: For campaign-style delivery checks: pass `recipient_email` and we auto-classify the provider via MX, picking ONE matching seed (vs the manual mode which fans across all seeds). Custom-domain recipients fall back to the `ldm` spam-analyzer seed.

skills.name: Create a deliverability test (manual mode)
skills.description: Returns a seed mailbox the caller must send their campaign email to (with the +token plus-addressing). Workers then poll the seed via IMAP and report placement (inbox/spam/other/not_received); polling backs off over up to a 2h window before giving up (api#27).

skills.name: Delete a test (irreversible)
skills.description: Removes the test, its results, and any associated screenshot jobs. Cannot be undone.

skills.name: Fetch test status + results (JSON or PDF)
skills.description: Returns full test snapshot: status (waiting/done/expired), per-seed results (placement, spf/dkim/dmarc, screenshot URL), aggregate summary, verdict, and recommendations. Pass `?format=pdf` or `Accept: application/pdf` to download a PDF report instead — requires `reports:pdf` scope.

format.description: Response format. Default `json`. Use `pdf` for a downloadable report.

skills.name: List own tests (paginated by created_at cursor)
skills.description: Returns tests created by this API key, newest first. Use `?cursor=<created_at>` to page back.

skills.name: Schedule a same-message placement recheck
skills.description: Schedules a durable re-scan of the original message after delay_hours (24 by default). Does not send a new email and does not consume test quota. Use GET /api/v1/tests/{token}/recheck-status to read both snapshots and the transition matrix.

delay_hours.description: Delay before the same-message recheck. Defaults to 24 hours.

skills.name: Get delayed placement snapshots and transitions
skills.description: Get delayed placement snapshots and transitions

skills.name: Force IMAP re-poll of a test (within cooldown)
skills.description: Triggers a one-shot IMAP fetch on every seed of this test. 30s cooldown per token. Quota NOT consumed (no email sent). Useful when delivery is delayed past the auto-window.
